text: 1、市场全天低开震荡，三大指数集体调整。培育钻石概念股走强，黄河旋风、恒盛能源涨停。创新药、CRO概念拉升，万邦医药、三力制药涨停。汽车整车股反弹，众泰汽车、安凯客车、海马汽车涨停。PCB概念股活跃，科翔股份、满坤科技等近10股涨停。下跌方面，农业股迎来调整，敦煌种业、新农开发跌停。个股涨多跌少，沪深京三市超3000股飘红，今日成交1.64万亿，较上周五缩量3440亿元，续创年内次低单日成交记录。截止收盘沪指跌0.07%，深成指跌0.64%，创业板指跌1.1%。 2、板块概念方面，培育钻石、创新药、汽车整车、PCB等板块涨幅居前，农业、军工、教育、旅游等
text_en: 1. The market opened lower and fluctuated throughout the day, with all three major indices adjusting collectively. Cultivated diamond concept stocks strengthened, with Huanghe Whirlwind and Hesheng Energy hitting the daily limit. Innovative drugs and CRO concepts rose, with Wanbang Pharmaceutical and Sanli Pharmaceutical hitting the daily limit. Automobile整车 stocks rebounded, with Zotye Auto, Ankai Bus, and Haima Automobile hitting the daily limit. PCB concept stocks were active, with nearly 10 stocks including Kexiang shares and Mankun Technology hitting the daily limit. On the decline, agricultural stocks underwent adjustment, with Dunhuang Seed and Xinnong Development hitting the daily limit down. More stocks rose than fell, with over 3,000 stocks in the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets posting gains. Today's turnover was 1.64 trillion yuan, a shrinkage of 344 billion yuan from last Friday, setting a second-lowest single-day turnover record for the year. As of the close, the Shanghai Composite Index fell 0.07%, the Shenzhen Component Index fell 0.64%, and the ChiNext Index fell 1.1%. 2.
